title: Ceftriaxone exerts antitumor effects in MYCN-driven retinoblastoma and neuroblastoma by targeting DDX3X for translation repression.
authors: Chittavanich, Pamorn; Saengwimol, Duangporn; Roytrakul, Sittiruk; Rojanaporn, Duangnate; Chaitankar, Vijender; Srimongkol, Atthapol; Anurathapan, Usanarat; Hongeng, Suradej; Kaewkhaw, Rossukon
one_liner_zh: 该文研究头孢曲松通过靶向DDX3X抑制MYCN驱动肿瘤的翻译，属于药物抗肿瘤机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: MYCN proto-oncogene, bHLH transcription factor (MYCN) amplification is associated with aggressive retinoblastoma (RB) and neuroblastoma (NB) cancer recurrence that is resistant to chemotherapies. Therefore, there is an urgent need to identify new therapeutic tools. This study aimed to evaluate the potential repurposing of ceftriaxone for the treatment of MYCN-amplified RB and NB, based on the clinical observations that the drug was serendipitously found to decrease the volume of the MYCN-driven RB subtype. Using patient-derived tumor organoids and tumor cell lines, we demonstrated that ceftriaxone is a potent and selective growth inhibitor targeting MYCN-driven RB and NB cells. Profiling of drug-induced transcriptomic changes, cell-cycle progression, and apoptotic death indicated cell-cycle arrest and death of drug-treated MYCN-amplified tumor cells. Drug target identification, using an affinity-based proteomic and molecular docking approach, and functional studies of the target proteins revealed that ceftriaxone targeted DEAD-box helicase 3 X-linked (DDX3X), thereby inhibiting translation in MYCN-amplified tumors but not in MYCN-nonamplified cells. The data suggest the feasibility of repurposing ceftriaxone as an anticancer drug and provide insights into the mechanism of drug action, highlighting DDX3X as a potential target for treating MYCN-driven tumors.
abstract_zh: MYCN原癌基因、bHLH转录因子（MYCN）扩增与侵袭性视网膜母细胞瘤（RB）和神经母细胞瘤（NB）的癌症复发相关，且这些复发对化疗具有耐药性。因此，迫切需要识别新的治疗工具。本研究旨在评估头孢曲松（ceftriaxone）在治疗MYCN扩增型RB和NB中的潜在再利用价值，基于临床观察发现该药物偶然降低了MYCN驱动的RB亚型肿瘤体积。利用患者来源的肿瘤类器官和肿瘤细胞系，我们证明头孢曲松是一种强效且选择性的生长抑制剂，靶向MYCN驱动的RB和NB细胞。药物诱导的转录组变化、细胞周期进程和凋亡死亡分析表明，药物处理的MYCN扩增肿瘤细胞发生细胞周期阻滞和死亡。通过基于亲和力的蛋白质组学和分子对接方法进行药物靶点鉴定，以及对靶蛋白的功能研究，揭示头孢曲松靶向DEAD-box解旋酶3 X连锁（DDX3X），从而抑制MYCN扩增肿瘤中的翻译，但对MYCN非扩增细胞无此作用。数据表明，将头孢曲松重新用作抗癌药物具有可行性，并提供了药物作用机制的见解，强调DDX3X是治疗MYCN驱动肿瘤的潜在靶点。
